# 🔥 PICKABOOM — FREE 11 PLAYER VR CHAOS 🔥
Drop onto a hostile planet with up to 11 friends. Physically mine glowing crystals. Escape monsters in collapsing caves. The deeper you go… the darker it gets.

🎮 100% Free | 👥 11 Player Online Co-Op | 🦍 Gorilla-Style VR Movement | 🆕 Weekly Updates

[media]

# WHY IT HITS DIFFERENT IN VR

**⛏️ Real Physical Mining**

Smash crystals with your own arms. Grab loot. Run when the lights flicker out.

**👾 Relentless Cave Creatures**

Big. Loud. Close. If your flashlight dies, you’re not alone.

**🌍 Massive Open World Caves**

No path. No safety. Go deeper. Survive longer.

**🐔💣 Craft Wild Gadgets**

Loot resources → Upgrade weapons → Go deeper.
From utility tools to the legendary Chicken Bomb.

[media]

# 😎 START FREE. LOOK ICONIC.

• 4 FREE starter avatars

• Deep DNA customization

• Limited weekly Skins drops

[media]

# 📸 BUILT FOR CONTENT

• Pull out your in-game camera anytime.

• Capture chaos. Post clips. Go viral.

• PICKABOOM is built for TikTok and YouTube moments.

[media]

# 🌍 COMMUNITY + LIVE EVENTS

• Join one of the most active social VR Discord communities.

• Contests. Dev events. Creator programs. Weekly drops.


# ✅ Built in Unity. Featured by Unity.
# 👉 Download PICKABOOM for FREE and survive the chaos.
